properties.REMARKS: For agricultural activity, the natural flow path was partially blocked by constructing random rubble walls, which further added material to the debris flow. Houses were constructed along the flow path of the seasonal stream, by blocking the water flow. A
properties.COMMUNICATION_AFFECTED: Road was temporarily blocked for 4 days
properties.PRE_REMEDIAL_MEASURES: Unstable debris material on the upslope as well as along the slide course needs to be removed.  No settlement should be allowed along and near vicinity of the slide course. Slab culvert across the road needs to be constructed for the free flow of water a
properties.INFRASTRUCTURE_AFFECTED: 1 RCC house completely destroyed, 1 RCC house partially damaged.
properties.GEOSCIENTIFIC_CAUSE: The geo-scientific cause of the slide was increase in pore water pressure and decrease in shear strength of the overburden material resulting in failure of slope along with heavy discharge of debris and water.

properties.REMARKS: In the slide zone, loose debris material is still present, which may lead to recurrence of the slide in the event of future heavy rain fall.

properties.GEOSCIENTIFIC_CAUSE:
Preparatory Factor: 
Presence of loose transported soil.
Wetness in the material.
Acceleratory Factors: 
Constant thrusting by pond water on its side walls.
Saturation of material due to weakness thereby loosing the strength.

properties.CITATION: Kuthe, S. and Kamble, A., (2020) Macro-scale (1:50,000) Landslide Susceptibility Mapping in parts of Toposheets 47E/16, 47F/09 & 47F/13 in parts of Pune and Raigad districts, Maharashtra.
properties.REMARKS: Due to steep slopes (upside escarpment) there may be probable risk of rock fall from upslope during heavy rain, which may cause threat to life. An immediate attention is needed for execution of protection measures.
properties.PRE_REMEDIAL_MEASURES:
No further Slope cutting
Removal of loose boulders from the slope clearance of toe drain.
Suitably designed guide walls along affected slope.
Awareness during rainy season.
properties.GEOSCIENTIFIC_CAUSE:
Preparatory Factor: Presence of steep slope.
Acceleratory Factors: Loosening of strength of soil due to saturation/moisture and root penetration.

Intermittent fall of the loose rock blocks causing inconvenience
to passing traffic.

properties.PRE_REMEDIAL_MEASURES: i) Erection of Landslide warning sign board; ii) Surface drainage management on crown portion of hill slope as well as for hill side drains; iii) Manual removal of precarious rock blocks, if any, after proper identification.
properties.INFRASTRUCTURE_AFFECTED: Loss to civil structures viz. road, retention structures as informed by HPPWD authorities
